title: Officer Style
features:
OFFICER STYLE
* A decent style relying on combos to deal great damage output. Based off of Tanimura's fighting style. (great with 1v1s)
  * Moveset combos made to match Tanimura's yakuza 4.
  * KEY FEATURES
  * Does NOT have double finishing blows.
  * Essence of Combos 1-4. (5th is the same as 1), instead of pressing the finishing blow button after a finishing blow, press the grab. Climax heat.
  * The grab toss is replaced by Guru Parry.
  * Guru Parry is replaced with Counter Quickstep.
  * Like Tanimura in Yakuza 4 he sucks at fighting multiple enemies. Unintentionally this style also does too unless you just counter hook lol.
